title: No Answer from Darnassus

texts.details:
You are sailing for the mainland? Then you are leaving the bough for the root of things, and you should know what waits there.

Darkshore is an old coast. The Highborne had cities on it before the Sundering, and their ghosts still walk the ruins of Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran. The Blackwood furbolgs have gone the way of our Gnarlpine. And of late the sea has been throwing dead things up the beach, great ones, and no one can say why.

Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine is gathering what is known. Tell him the Circle in Darnassus has had his letters, and that the Arch Druid has sent no answer. He will know what that means.
texts.objectives: Take the boat from Rut'theran Village and bring Daryn Lightwind's word to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, in Darkshore.
texts.completion:
No answer. I had stopped expecting one.

Then Auberdine sees to itself, as it has since the tree was planted and Darnassus stopped looking down. Walk the beach in either direction and you will find what the sea has left us. Walk inland and you will find the furbolgs, and the ruins beyond them.

We have few hands here, $N. If yours are free, stay a while.

idea: On the road from Teldrassil to Darkshore: the Highborne ruins, the maddened Blackwood, the creatures washing ashore, and a Darnassus that does not answer.
